subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive

Marissa -

Thanks again for running the discovery with our team this morning. Helpful conversation; I think we have good alignment on high level goals (reduce inference cost and stabilize latency for our edge fleet).

Next step from our side is an exec intro so our CTO can meet Redwood leadership and confirm org-level buy-in. Can we schedule a short VP/CTO alignment (15-20m) next week? After that we'd like to do a deeper technical session (60m) with your SE to go through integration details and security/ops checklist.

Our rough availability (PDT):
- Tue 5/25: 09:00-11:00 or 15:00-17:00
- Wed 5/26: 10:00-12:00
- Thu 5/27: 09:00-11:00

I've attached our initial security questionnaire (acme_security_q1.pdf) - you can send over anything you want us to pre-read.

Attendees we expect: Oliver Grant (CTO), Samir Patel (Head of AI), and a product PM. Please include the SE and account exec from Redwood.

Thanks - let me know what works.

Samir
Head of AI, Acme Robotics
samir.patel@acme-robotics.com

Samir - great to hear and thanks for the recaps. Glad the discovery was useful.

We'd be happy to set up both calls. Proposed plan:
1) Exec alignment (VP/CTO) - 20 mins to align on high-level success criteria and timelines
2) Technical deep dive - 60 mins with Marcus as SE to cover integration approach, KV cache expectations, quantization tradeoffs, and ops/SLA implications

Open slots (PDT):
- Tue 5/25: 10:00-10:20 or 15:30-15:50
- Thu 5/27: 09:30-09:50

If none of those work, here's our short scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood-exec/30min

I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan (Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx) that outlines proposed milestones and owners - happy to iterate. Marcus, Vivek - can you join the thread for scheduling and call prep?

Thanks,

Samir / Marissa - happy to run the technical deep dive. For the 60m session I'd like to cover:
- Current inference topology & peak/median tail latency
- Model variants you expect to serve and token profiles
- KV/prefix cache opportunities and expected token reuse
- Integration touchpoints (auth, VPC peering, KMS)
- Example throughput targets and sizing guidance

I can share a short deck ahead of the call: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1techdeck-example.

My availability aligns with Marissa's windows - prefer Tue 5/25 10:00 or Thu 5/27 09:30.
